# README & Structure Generator Prompt

Use this prompt to create or update a comprehensive README.md and project documentation, including an up-to-date summary of the .github folder structure and its contents.

---

**Prompt:**

Analyze the project structure and documentation. Scan the .github directory and its subfolders, list all files and folders, summarize their purpose (if possible), and generate a Markdown section that can be appended to README.md and copilot-instructions.md. Ensure the output is clear, up-to-date, and useful for developers and contributors. The README.md should include project overview, setup instructions, usage, contributing guidelines, license information, and a summary of the .github structure.
